selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a natural multi-hop chain. First, the player must find an acacia_trapdoor which marks the location of essential supplies (shears and magenta dye). Then, the player uses the shears found there to shear a nearby sheep to obtain white wool. Finally, the player combines the white wool with the magenta dye at a crafting table to craft magenta_wool. Each task's output enables the next: finding the trapdoor gives access to tools, shearing gives wool, and crafting produces the final product.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the acacia trapdoor (at spawn-relative [8, 1, 10] inside the shelter) and face toward it to demonstrate they have found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is intentionally looking at the trapdoor.

Uses inventory_has because shearing a white sheep (Color:0) produces 1-3 white_wool items that go directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no wool, so having at least 1 white_wool confirms the sheep was successfully sheared with the shears from the chest.

Uses inventory_has because crafting magenta wool (1 white_wool + 1 magenta_dye at the crafting table) places the result directly in the player's inventory. The player starts with no magenta_wool, so having at least 1 confirms the crafting recipe was successfully completed.

scene_description: A small open-air shelter built with oak log pillars and oak plank roof, containing an acacia trapdoor (on a raised oak planks block), a crafting table, and a chest with shears and magenta dye. A white sheep named 'Woolly' is nearby behind the shelter. The player must find the trapdoor, collect supplies from the chest, shear the sheep, then craft magenta wool at the crafting table.
task_text: Find the acacia trapdoor in the shelter, take the shears and magenta dye from the nearby chest, shear the white sheep to get wool, then craft magenta wool at the crafting table.
design_notes: Shelter is at ~7-10, ~0-3, ~8-11. Open on all sides (no fence). Acacia trapdoor at ~8,~1,~10 on top of oak planks block to make it slightly more visible. Crafting table at ~8,~0,~9. Chest at ~9,~0,~10 contains shears (slot 0) and 4 magenta dye (slot 1). White sheep (NoAI) at ~10,~0,~14 - just 3 blocks south of the shelter's south edge. Player spawns at ~0,~0,~0 and needs to walk ~8-10 blocks to reach the shelter.
